resource_sample.scope: Real final installed development workspace, warm session. Owner applications retained. Source check and compiler finished. No controlled before/after or frame-pacing test.
resource_sample.remote_scope: Whole service cgroup start processes, including capture helper, at this sample workload. An idle/no-viewer sample does not establish active phone-stream cost.
resource_sample.rss_scope: Summed process RSS double-counts shared pages; it is not PSS.

full_native_check.scope: Maintained just check on native physical x86 host; live installed-session acceptance recorded separately
full_native_check.additional_checks: Shell, catalogue, image, visual, compatibility and native runtime gates also execute in just check; unittest count is not the total assertion count.

first_failures_preserved: AbstractButton states incorrectly treated as undeclared by static gate

Adding the release note exceeded the existing bounded reader on ARM; retired only the obsolete 2026-09-17 Arabic edge-alignment announcement, now contradicted by the centered date. Kept reader bound and every shipped-entry survival check unchanged.

A remaining Horizon test still required the retired five-column row dividers. Replaced only that obsolete layout assertion with no-orphan-cell and visibility-dependent spans; native tests also require a single card to reclaim full width and all visible rows to fill height. The 28 Horizon controls and 28 native language/orientation/visibility cases pass.

Maintained Mira integration caught a removed Home entry. Restore the direct Mira destination rather than waive the contract. Native Home now keeps four reachable actions and the Store remains reachable from App library.
qualification.control_corrections: Replace obsolete visual assertions with actual identity/input/tooltip controls; keep typo and wrong-root-state refusals. Preserve all boot, identity and data-loss gates.
qualification.native_kcm_source_build: Seven Release modules built in the existing SDK container; no new image/VM/container installed. Owned idle SDK stopped after compilation.
qualification.release_note: Bilingual native-workspace-composition entry opens actual MoOS Settings; 30 reader/notifier/image-gate controls pass after obsolete announcement retirement.
qualification.actual_native_defect: A real Home Mira click did nothing: installed Kicker normalized configured desktop IDs into applications: URLs, while openDesktop searched raw IDs. A private native model reproduces the mismatch; fixed/old/unknown/failed-activation controls pass, and actual Mira and Store buttons now launch their native applications.

intentional_stop.reason: Stopped only owned source check while correcting an actual missing Mira icon found in pixels. Not a passing gate.

qualification.release_note_timestamp: The new announcement is dated the following UTC morning so its merged time cannot precede the planned integration; the bounded reader is unchanged.
